parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: A cardboard flap forming part of the box lid, capable of rotating to open or close the box.
parts.Functional_description: It helps cover and protect the contents of the box when folded inward or outward.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around the fold line connecting it to the base body.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: A side flap of the box made of cardboard, part of the lid assembly.
parts.Functional_description: It assists in closing the box securely and maintaining its shape.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates along its hinge line to fold over the box opening.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: A cardboard flap forming one of the longer sides of the box lid.
parts.Functional_description: It provides coverage and structural support when the box is closed.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates outward or inward depending on the opening direction.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: A smaller flap of the box lid made of cardboard.
parts.Functional_description: It helps interlock with other flaps to secure the box closure.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates along a crease line to fold over the box opening.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: A cardboard flap that forms part of the top closure of the box.
parts.Functional_description: It contributes to sealing the box and protecting its contents.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates around its fold line to open or close the box.

parts.name: Rotation Lid
parts.Basic_description: A cardboard flap that acts as one of the top covers of the box.
parts.Functional_description: It helps in closing the box and maintaining its rectangular shape.
parts.Movement_description: It rotates along the hinge line to fold over the box opening.

parts.name: Base Body
parts.Basic_description: The main body of the box made of cardboard, forming the container’s base and sides.
parts.Functional_description: It holds and supports the contents of the box, providing structural integrity.
parts.Movement_description: It remains stationary while the lids rotate around its upper edges.
